description: Discover recently modified files under explicitly approved local roots, with every root bound to one profile scope.

onboarding.question: Which local folders should the close inspect for recently changed files?
setup_questions: Which exact folder root is approved?
Which single profile scope owns that root?
How many days of changes and which file extensions should be considered?
connector_probes: Verify each configured root exists without reading file contents.
optional_artifacts: Normalized recent-file metadata emitted by scripts/collect_local_files.py.
